dedupe_keys.name: marine diesel engine thermal and performance fault data

description: Xie, Mo and Jia publish a multi-source parameter dataset for marine diesel-engine thermal fault diagnosis. The public Figshare version one lists CSV files from calibrated simulations, engine-bench measurements, real-vessel telemetry and fused fault cases under CC BY 4.0. Its own metadata describes 24 transient gas-path and in-cylinder performance variables over 25 to 100 percent engine load, with a healthy state and ten fault modes. Coverage is engine-bench, real-vessel and simulated conditions at 25 to 100 percent engine load. No directly related catalogue record was identified. A vessel modeller could use the data to check an engine digital twin or condition-dependent propulsion-resilience scenarios. A caveat is that some faults are constructed through virtual-real fusion because destructive failure tests aboard a vessel are impractical. The archive mixes measured and simulated records, so their provenance should remain separate during validation. The observations concern particular engine conditions, not all maritime fleets or long-term degradation. I read the own Figshare metadata and file manifest without downloading CSVs, assessing sensor calibration or reproducing the reported fault classifier.
